args.lesson: Actual inline UI execution under a Node DOM stub independently verified confirmation, exact findings, download wiring and invalidation, beyond producer core parity. All seven checks passed and the dry_run digest matched. This supports only the disclosed free prototype: a DOM stub does not establish real browser behavior, Shopify compatibility, customer demand or sale readiness. Next deployment must retain provider independence and the host gate; prioritize observed usage or delivery issues over further speculative features.

description: Independent UI-wiring checks passed 7/7 and reproduced the candidate digest, supporting a free prototype release through the host gate. Real browser execution and Shopify imports remain untested. Three unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown; no funding or revenue is verified. Missing collection blocks paid acceptance, not free exposure.
